an5.194:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati, mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an5.194:1.2: tena kho pana samayena. kāraṇapālī brāhmaṇo licchavīnaṃ kammantaṃ kāreti.
an5.194:1.3: addasā kho kāraṇapālī brāhmaṇo piṅgiyāniṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
an5.194:2.1: handa kuto nu bhavaṃ piṅgiyānī āgacchati divādivassāti.
an5.194:2.2: itohaṃ bho āgacchāmi, samaṇassa gotamassa santikāti.
an5.194:2.3: taṃ kiṃ maññati bhavaṃ piṅgiyānī samaṇassa gotamassa paññāveyyattiyaṃ, paṇḍito maññeti?
an5.194:2.4: ko cā haṃ bho, ko ca samaṇassa gotamassa paññāveyyattiyaṃ jānissāmi.
an5.194:2.5: sopi nūnassa tādisova yo samaṇassa gotamassa paññāveyyattiyaṃ jāneyyāti.
an5.194:2.6: uḷārāya khalu bhavaṃ piṅgiyānī samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pasaṃsāya pasaṃsatīti.
an5.194:2.7: ko cāhaṃ bho, ko ca samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pasaṃsissāmi,
an5.194:2.8: pasattha pasatthova so bhavaṃ gotamo seṭṭho devamanussānanti.
an5.194:2.9: kiṃ pana bhavaṃ piṅgiyānī atthavasaṃ sampassamāno samaṇe gotame evaṃ abhippasanno?ti.
an5.194:3.1: seyyathāpi bho puriso aggarasaparititto na aññesaṃ hīnānaṃ rasānaṃ piheti,
an5.194:3.2: evameva kho bho, yato yato tassa bhoto gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti:
an5.194:3.3: yadi suttaso yadi geyyaso yadi veyyākaraṇaso yadi abbhūtadhammaso,
an5.194:3.4: tato tato na aññesaṃ puthusamaṇa brāhmaṇappavādānaṃ piheti. (1)
an5.194:4.1: seyyathāpi bho puriso jighacchādubbalyapareto madhupiṇḍikaṃ adhigaccheyya,
an5.194:4.2: so yato yato sāyetha, labhateva sādhurasaṃ asecanakaṃ,
an5.194:4.3: evameva kho bho, yato yato tassa bhoto gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti.
an5.194:4.4: yadi suttaso yadi geyyaso yadi veyyākaraṇaso yadi abbhūtadhammaso,
an5.194:4.5: tato tato labhateva attamanataṃ, labhati cetaso pasādaṃ. (2)
an5.194:5.4: yadi mūlato yadi majjhato yadi aggato,
an5.194:5.6: evameva kho bho, yato yato tassa bhoto gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti:
an5.194:5.7: yadi suttaso yadi geyyaso yadi veyyākaraṇaso yadi abbhūtadhammaso,
an5.194:5.8: tato tato adhigacchati pāmojjaṃ, adhigacchati somanassaṃ. (3)
an5.194:6.1: seyyathāpi bho puriso ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno,
an5.194:6.2: tassa kusalo bhisakko ṭhānaso ābādhaṃ nīhareyya,
an5.194:6.3: evameva kho bho, yato yato tassa bhoto gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti:
an5.194:6.4: yadi suttaso yadi geyyaso yadi veyyākaraṇaso yadi abbhūtadhammaso,
an5.194:7.1: seyyathāpi bho pokkharaṇī acchodakā sātodakā sītodakā setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā,
an5.194:7.2: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito,
an5.194:7.3: so taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā nahātvā ca pītvā ca sabbadarathakilamathapariḷāhaṃ paṭippassambheyya.
an5.194:7.4: evameva kho bho, yato yato tassa bhoto gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti
an5.194:7.5: yadi suttaso yadi geyyaso yadi veyyākaraṇaso yadi abbhūtadhammaso,
an5.194:8.1: evaṃ vutte kāraṇapālī brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā dakkhiṇajāṇumaṇḍalaṃ paṭhaviyaṃ nihantvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
an5.194:12.1: abhikkantaṃ bho piṅgiyānī, abhikkantaṃ bho piṅgiyānī.
an5.194:12.2: seyyathāpi bho piṅgiyānī, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya ‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhinti’ti, evamevaṃ bhotā piṅgiyāninā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito,
an5.194:12.3: esāhaṃ bho piṅgiyānī taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi, dhammaṃ ca bhikkhusaṃghañca.
an5.194:12.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ piṅgiyānī dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
